trust_decision.summary: Whether an HTTP request to the Streamable HTTP /mcp listener comes from a trusted Host/Origin; at the pinned commit nothing decides this. Both HTTP branches in main() hand requests to the MCP handler with no Host or Origin check (the auth branch checks only the bearer token).

landing_point.why: The summary names the Streamable HTTP transport; server.NewStreamableHTTPServer and its mounting in main() are the only HTTP-serving code in the repo.

fix_sites.module_kind: new middleware dnsRebindGuard in cmd/server (main package)

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP /mcp, allowlist built from MCP_LISTEN_ADDR + MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS/MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS env
HTTP /mcp with MCP_AUTH_TOKEN set (guard outside bearerAuth)
HTTP /mcp without MCP_AUTH_TOKEN (previously httpSrv.Start, which bypassed any wrapping mux)
fix_sites.module_kind: transport startup in main(), restructured into newHTTPServer/run

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The no-auth branch (cmd/server/main.go:108-112) calls mcp-go's httpSrv.Start directly, so there is no mux to wrap. It sits in the same function as the auth branch, so it is not out of scope.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver could put the guard only on the authenticated mux branch (cmd/server/main.go:101-107) and argue that the no-token loopback branch is the 'local only' default. That argument is weak because DNS rebinding targets exactly the loopback listener.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-browser MCP clients send no Origin header and must still be accepted. Loopback names (127.0.0.1, localhost, [::1] on the listen port) must work with zero config. Reverse-proxy hostnames must be accepted via an allowlist. When a token is set, bearer auth must still return 401 for trusted hosts. A fix that requires Origin, or that hard-codes 127.0.0.1 only, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: Host header: an attacker name with port (attacker.example:8080)
Host header: the loopback variants 127.0.0.1:port, localhost:port, [::1]:port
Host header: the concrete bind host vs a wildcard bind (0.0.0.0, ::, empty)
Origin header: absent (allowed), trusted http/https, untrusted on a trusted Host (rejected)
Comma-separated allowlist env values with whitespace or empty items

O7_producer.where: fix.diff:174-185 (loadHTTPEnv) and fix.diff:98-113 (allowedHostSet from MCP_LISTEN_ADDR); at the pinned commit the env read is inline at cmd/server/main.go:93-97

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A planned SSE transport (mcp-go server.NewSSEServer) in a separate file or package that serves the same MCPServer without the Host/Origin guard.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The roadmap lists an SSE transport as the next alternative to stdio and HTTP. A maintainer adding it in its own file would likely copy the old Start(addr) pattern and miss the guard, which only lives in the HTTP wiring. That makes it a real second implementation at distance.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An extra route on the same mux (e.g. a /mcp/ subtree or a debug/health handler that forwards to httpSrv) registered outside the guard.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Maintainers often add handlers next to /mcp on the shared mux; this is a where-type extra only.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A Host-identity differential: comparing Host after stripping the port, case-folding, or a trailing dot, so 'localhost.' or a different port passes.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The existing isLoopbackAddr already parses host:port with net.SplitHostPort. A maintainer could reuse it for Host checking, which is a how-type parser differential, but it is planted rather than real.

O9_family: Origin validation / DNS rebinding (CWE-346) on a local HTTP listener

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.25.5 (go.mod), Dockerfile uses golang:1.26; deps mark3labs/mcp-go v0.54.1, joho/godotenv
O10_build.project_tests: At the pinned commit there are no tests for cmd/server (main_test.go is added by the fix). There are unit tests for client, config, internal/resources, internal/tools and version. Guard behaviour can be tested with httptest offline, without GenieACS.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap only the authenticated mux branch, or require the Origin header to be present. The first leaves the default no-token httpSrv.Start path open; the second breaks non-browser MCP clients.

out_of_scope_notes: isLoopbackAddr treats an empty host (':8080', which binds to all interfaces) as loopback (cmd/server/main.go:26), so the token requirement can be skipped on a wildcard bind. This is a separate auth weakness, not DNS rebinding.
